correctness.rationale: In RESULT.md, Schatten-ratio equality iff rank one follows from strict convexity of t^(q/p) on positive singular-value p-masses (q=infinity via max); compact p-unit spheres also work for p<1. Rank-one projective Segre dimension 2n-2 in P^(n^2-1) and projective intersection theorem force any linear test F of dim >=(n-1)^2+1 to intersect rank-one. The Grassmannian incidence count N-d=2n-1 greater than Segre dimension constructs a disjoint dim (n-1)^2 plane. Dimension/codim quantifiers give first loss at 2n. For real 2x2 det signature (2,2), every 3-plane meets det=0 and conformal 2-plane span{I,J} has equal singular values. Universal two-singular-value lower ratio beta is attained. Both endpoints and all 0<p<q<=infinity are included; no exact c_(2n) for n>2.
